description: Given a Supabase schema (supabase db dump output, migrations, or CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY / CREATE POLICY / CREATE VIEW / CREATE FUNCTION statements), work out for every table exposed through the Data API and every command whether anyone with the public anon key, any signed-in user, only the row's owner, or nobody can do it, applying PostgreSQL's policy rules. Flags RLS off, using (true), authenticated-only conditions, UPDATE with a weaker WITH CHECK, policies reading user_metadata, views without security_invoker and exposed SECURITY DEFINER functions, each with a SQL fix and an instruction for an AI coding tool. Use it before shipping or after editing policies. Static analysis only: it never connects to a database. Up to about 60 KB of SQL.

sql.description: The schema SQL: tables, RLS statements, policies, views and functions. No data needed.

name: analyze_supabase_rls
title: Supabase RLS attack simulator
